Which, of course, brings me to the concept of friendship. Because what *is* friendship, really? It’s a fascinating question! The word ‘friend’ itself derives from the Old English word ‘frēond,’ which meant ‘lover’ or ‘beloved.’ And that, in turn, comes from the Proto-Germanic word ‘frijōndą,’ which meant ‘possessed by a lord.’ So, initially, a friend was someone who was essentially a vassal or a dependent! Then, over time, the meaning shifted, evolving through various linguistic changes and cultural influences.
